shortDescription: UPSC has released the ESE / ESEP Recruitment 2027 notification. Candidates can apply online from 16 September 2026 to 06 October 2026 for 480 engineering vacancies.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the recruitment notification for Engineering Services Examination (ESE / ESEP) 2027. The official advertisement invites online applications for 480 engineering vacancies across Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics & Telecom disciplines.

Eligible candidates can apply online from 16 September 2026 to 06 October 2026 through the official UPSC portal.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 16 September 2026
  • Last date to apply online: 06 October 2026 up to 6 PM
  • Fee payment last date: 06 October 2026
  • Preliminary exam date: 31 January 2027
  • Mains exam date: 18 June 2027
  • Admit card: Before exam

Vacancy details

Total vacancies: 480 posts
Disciplines: Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

Eligibility

Applicants must hold an engineering degree in the relevant discipline from a recognized university. Age limit is 21 to 30 years as on 01/01/2027 with applicable relaxation as per UPSC rules.

Application fee

General, OBC and EWS candidates: Rs. 200. SC, ST, PH and all female candidates: Nil. Payment can be made through online methods such as debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.

Selection process

The recruitment process comprises the Preliminary Examination, the Main Examination and an Interview / Personality Test.
